title: The Perpetual Alchemical Crucible Sum
statement:
Given an array of distinct integers Candidates and a target integer T, return a list of all unique combinations of Candidates where the chosen numbers sum to T.
You may return the combinations in any order, but each individual combination must be sorted in non-decreasing order.
The same number may be chosen from Candidates an unlimited number of times.

Print each combination on a new line. If no combination exists, print NONE.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and T.
Second line: N space-separated distinct integers.
